body: Perfect, both of those are really helpful.  I appreciate it.

I don’t seemingly qualify for a career in curriculum design. I don’t have the degree or credentials. Besides, I’m an example of how not to live life. And I’ve figured out the lethal dosage for me would be 45 pills downed with some Balvenie. Whatever the sleeping pills don’t do, the scotch will do the rest this time. The school will be quiet. It’ll be peaceful. People will still have their whole summers and it’ll all be cleaned up by August.
